title: Trevor Lawrence is having by far the best season of his career

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Trevor Lawrence is having by far the best season of his career
sources.description: Trevor Lawrence has so much talent for the quarterback position that if freshmen could declare for the NFL draft, Lawrence probably would have been the first overall pick in 2019, when he had just led Clemson to a national championship as a true freshman.
